purpose: Preserve current targets and give nonpersonal statistical support a positive selection probability
primary_area_budget: extra max(10% of matched current area, largest candidate cell area), minimum one whole res9 safety cell
random_sampling: K=floor(extra_budget/max_candidate_cell_area); K independent draws with replacement proportional to literature cell mass, deduplicate; geographic area cannot exceed extra budget
scope: Only positive-mass literature cells outside current alert targets; no true positions used in generation or selection
seeding: existing person seed plus hour via numpy SeedSequence; synthetic labels excluded; replayable sample at same snapshot
expected_inclusion: baseline included=1; otherwise 1-(1-q_cell/Q_outside)^K, zero outside literature support
static_target_limitation: top density leaves other cells permanently out; weighted rotation is experimental, not a production trigger or push policy
promotion: No automatic promotion from synthetic mean results; await area-priority preference and new validation.
